name: Sustainer-Class
role: High-capacity fleet replenishment, fuel and drive-consumable transport, bulk stores carriage, fabrication-feedstock delivery, ordnance support, and sustained campaign logistics.
design_doctrine: A Sustainer is built to keep a major task group present after the first deployment wave. It carries the mass, reserves, replacement material, and transfer infrastructure that permit a flagship, escorts, aerospace wing, hosted craft, Sentinels, courts, medical systems, and field institutions to remain operational over a long campaign.
canonical_capabilities: Fabrication feedstock and structural replacement-material storage
Food, water, atmosphere-processing, and medical-reserve carriage
Spare parts and replacement systems for capital ships, escorts, hosted vessels, drones, and Sentinel equipment
Simultaneous replenishment of multiple receiving vessels
Docked, tethered, stand-off, shuttle, and drone-assisted transfer support
Cargo quarantine, contamination control, and hazardous-material isolation
Reinforced hull, layered shielding, and AI-coordinated point defense
Heavy cargo handling, tug, and repair-drone capacity
Campaign salvage, recoverable cargo, and outbound transfer handling

task_group_assignment.note: The standing Judicator fuel/supply bulker slot is occupied by the G.U.S. Continuance. Replacement requires a later owner-authorized event.

class_boundaries.reliant_comparison: The Reliant-Class is a balanced logistics, mobile-command, and battlefield-medical vessel. The Sustainer-Class is a larger and more specialized bulk replenishment hull optimized for fuel, stores, feedstock, ordnance, and sustained high-volume transfer.
class_boundaries.combat_boundary: A Sustainer is hardened and defensible but is not a frontline combatant. Its survival and cargo integrity take precedence over offensive engagement.
class_boundaries.resource_boundary: The class carries, conditions, secures, and transfers resources; it does not imply unlimited self-generation of fuel, ammunition, food, or replacement material.

staged_specifications.transfer_station_model: Four major replenishment stations plus distributed shuttle, drone, and utility interfaces; exact count and transfer physics remain STAGING.
staged_specifications.cargo_architecture_model: Armored central transfer spine with physically separated fuel, ordnance, life-support, medical, fabrication-feedstock, spare-parts, hazardous, and general-cargo districts.
staged_specifications.defense_model: Layered shields, distributed point defense, decoys, hardened cargo isolation, self-sealing transfer sections, and escort-integrated defensive networking.
staged_specifications.propulsion_model: FTL-capable fleet logistics drive optimized for reliability and loaded-mass handling rather than tactical acceleration; exact drive topology remains STAGING.
staged_specifications.embarked_craft_model: Heavy cargo shuttles, utility cutters, transfer tugs, tank-management drones, cargo drones, and repair drones; exact quantities remain STAGING.
staged_specifications.operational_limit: Major replenishment operations constrain maneuver, defensive geometry, and emergency departure readiness and therefore require deliberate escort coverage.

promotion_pass: Judicator Escort and Bulker Class Pass — 2026-07-21; Judicator Task Group Vessel Identity Pass — 2026-07-21
notes: Class identity, role, canonical capability families, and the Continuance assignment are owner-authorized CANON. Exact dimensions, complement, transfer-station count, drive implementation, cargo capacities, and embarked-craft quantities remain STAGING.
